title: Red Cross, Tiny's Tempo and the other tunes
summary: Red Cross was worked out with Parker, Tiny's Tempo was already in the book, and You'll Always Love Me was expected to do well.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: The only arrangement we had to get together was Red Cross.
That was Parker's tune, wasn't it?

Well I was in too, but I never did take any credit for it, 'cause I had something to do with part of the middle part, you know. We worked things out together. Like I said, we had been playing together awhile & things started happening. So we got that together right quick. That other thing, Tiny's tempo, I think we had been playing that.
I'll always love you just the same...
... That was a pretty good tune I thought that tune was gonna really do something. But the right person didn't do it.
Were the rest of the guys on that date in your regular group at that time?
The thing of it is, with Romance without Finance is at that particular time it was in the dissents class. Very low, but there. And the lyrics, they didn't like. The lyrics
didn't appeal to the public. Now they want it however.
